name: Departure
description: Follow the mystery of Flight 716 - a passenger plane that vanishes over the Atlantic Ocean. Following the mysterious crash, recently widowed, brilliant aviation investigator Kendra Malley is called in to investigate by her former boss and mentor Howard Lawson.

videos.title: Vanished
videos.overview: When TransOcean Flight 716 vanishes over the Atlantic Ocean with 256 people on board, crash investigator Kendra Malley is called in.

videos.title: Survivor
videos.overview: The hunt for wreckage continues as the TSIB team learn more about Donovan. Kendra wonders if the plane's lone survivor is hiding something.

videos.title: Prime Suspect
videos.overview: Madelyn’s memories of the crash provide the team with a lead, and a new witness comes forward with disturbing information about Donovan.

videos.title: Sabotage
videos.overview: Kendra tries to make sense of conflicting evidence and is stunned by the betrayal of someone close to her, while AJ puts his life in danger.

videos.title: Grounded
videos.overview: An unlikely source has proof of a conspiracy to cover up the truth about the crash, and the team scramble to recover the black boxes.

videos.title: Endgame
videos.overview: Kendra comes up with a plan to confront the Flight 716 conspirators and expose the cover up.

videos.title: Runaway
videos.overview: Kendra Malley is called to the U.S. to investigate a high-speed train crash in rural Michigan.

videos.title: Fugitive
videos.overview: Kendra learns about a mysterious passenger on the run after escaping from U.S. Marshals' custody.

videos.title: Walk the Line
videos.overview: Kendra shares information with her FBI counterpart; Kendra gets a big break in the case.

videos.title: Wrecking Ball
videos.overview: Kendra looks for connections between the victims; Max and Kendra hatch a plan with the FBI.

videos.title: Don't Tread on Me
videos.overview: Kendra and Agent Hunter find proof of a larger conspiracy; a confrontation leaves Kendra shaken.

videos.title: Witness
videos.overview: As the case winds down, Kendra feels there's still a missing piece of the puzzle.

videos.title: The Tempest
videos.overview: A night ferry crossing suddenly goes horribly wrong. Kendra Malley and her team are called in to investigate the sinking.

videos.title: Dead in the Water
videos.overview: Having found signs of life on board the sunken vessel, the race for recovery continues along with gathering of evidence. Survivors start experiencing flashbacks.

videos.title: Stowaway
videos.overview: Kendra Malley and her team continue to investigate the ferry sinking. The Captain's story comes into question, when a recovered video shows a different turn of events below deck, than was first told by survivors.

videos.title: Devil and the Deep Blue Sea
videos.overview: There is unexpected betrayal within the ranks, a possibly innocent man is arrested, and then a dead diver surfaces from the wreck.

videos.title: Shot Across The Bow
videos.overview: A diver's mysterious identity proves to be the key to Kendra's discovery that an ally has been sabotaging her investigation from the start.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Kendra and her team decides to go rogue in their quest to discover the true cause of the ferry's sinking.

country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States, Germany
